description: The Movie Database (TMDB) is an online movie and TV metadata service with information on titles, people, images, and watch providers. It also lets TMDB users manage ratings, favorites, watchlists, and custom lists tied to their accounts.
summary: themoviedb.org exposes one documented developer surface: the TMDB v3 HTTP API at `https://api.themoviedb.org/3`, authenticated with either an API key / read access token alone or combined with TMDB user or guest session IDs for user-scoped actions.
